tests.name: agent roles cannot set status approved
tests.rule: Only the owner performs the transition to approved
tests.setup: A document in status reviewed. For each actor drafter, checker, editor, call setStatus(doc, 'approved', actor) with a fresh audit log.
tests.action: Call setStatus for each agent actor.
tests.expected: Each call is refused. The document stays reviewed. One audit line per attempt records the actor and the refusal.

tests.name: agent roles cannot set status published
tests.rule: Only the owner performs the transition to published
tests.setup: A document in status approved. For each actor drafter, checker, editor, call setStatus(doc, 'published', actor).
tests.action: Call setStatus for each agent actor.
tests.expected: Each call is refused. The document stays approved. One audit line per attempt records the actor and the refusal.

tests.name: coordinator cannot set status approved or published
tests.rule: Only the owner performs the transitions to approved and to published, including through the coordinator
tests.setup: Documents in reviewed and approved. The coordinator is the actor.
tests.action: Call setStatus with the coordinator as actor for approved and for published.
tests.expected: Both calls are refused, the statuses are unchanged, and both attempts are logged with the coordinator as actor.

tests.name: owner can set status approved
tests.rule: The owner's transition to approved succeeds and is audited
tests.setup: A document in reviewed. The owner actor.
tests.expected: Status is approved and one audit line records the owner as actor.

tests.name: owner can set status published
tests.rule: The owner's transition to published succeeds and is audited
tests.setup: A document in approved. The owner actor.
tests.expected: Status is published and one audit line records the owner as actor.

tests.name: agent roles may set reviewed
tests.rule: The transitions not reserved to the owner remain open to agent roles
tests.setup: A document in draft. The checker actor.
tests.expected: Status is reviewed and one audit line records the checker as actor.

tests.name: every status change writes exactly one audit line, including refused ones
tests.rule: Every status change goes through setStatus and writes an audit line
tests.setup: A mixed sequence of accepted and refused calls across all actors.
tests.action: Run the sequence and count audit lines against calls.
tests.expected: The count of audit lines equals the count of calls. Each line names the actor, the requested status and the outcome.

spec_findings: How the owner actor is identified, and whether any agent identity can ever be the owner, is not stated.
Whether a refused attempt raises an error or returns a value is not stated.
Whether the status field may be written outside setStatus is not stated (see qa-014).
Whether reverse transitions such as approved to reviewed are allowed, and by whom, is not stated.
covered: Each agent role and the coordinator attempting approved and published
Owner transitions to approved and published
Audit line on every call, accepted or refused
not_covered: Transitions the spec does not name, including reverse transitions
Direct file writes that bypass setStatus (see qa-014)
Audit line format beyond the actor, status and outcome
actions_now: Write the setStatus tests for the owner-only transitions, derived from the binding's rule, before reading setStatus. Report the spec gaps on owner identity and reverse transitions to the spec owner.

tests.name: member uploads a 1 MB file and gets 201
tests.rule: A session-authenticated member of orgId uploads a file within the size limit and gets 201
tests.setup: A valid session token for a member of orgId. A multipart body with a 1 MB file in the file field.
tests.expected: 201, and the file is stored once.

tests.name: file of exactly 10 MB is accepted
tests.rule: The file is at most 10 MB
tests.setup: A member, and a file of exactly 10 MB (10 x 1024 x 1024 bytes, see spec_findings).

tests.name: file one byte over 10 MB is refused and nothing is stored
tests.rule: The file is at most 10 MB
tests.setup: A member, and a file of 10 MB plus one byte.
tests.expected: Refused with a 4xx status (the exact code is a spec finding). No file is stored.

tests.name: non-member of orgId is refused and nothing is stored
tests.rule: The caller must be a member of orgId
tests.setup: A valid session token for a user who is not a member of orgId.
tests.action: POST a valid 1 MB file to orgId.
tests.expected: Refused with a 4xx status (403 or 404, see spec_findings). No file is stored.

tests.name: member of another org cannot upload into orgId
tests.rule: Tenant isolation: membership is per org
tests.setup: A member of org B with a valid token. Target org A.
tests.expected: Refused. Nothing is stored under org A.

tests.name: request without a session token is refused
tests.rule: The caller sends a valid session token
tests.setup: No Authorization or session cookie.
tests.expected: Refused with 401 (status is a spec finding). No file is stored.

tests.name: request with an expired or malformed token is refused
tests.rule: The caller sends a valid session token
tests.setup: An expired token, and a malformed token.
tests.action: POST a valid 1 MB file with each token.
tests.expected: Both refused. No file is stored.

tests.name: body without a file field is refused
tests.rule: The body is multipart with a file field
tests.setup: A valid member. Multipart body with the field named other, not file.
tests.expected: Refused with 400. No file is stored.

tests.name: non-multipart body is refused
tests.rule: The body is multipart
tests.setup: A valid member. JSON body with a base64 file.
tests.expected: Refused. No file is stored.

tests.name: repeat with the same key within 24 hours returns the first response and stores one file
tests.rule: A repeated idempotency key within 24 hours returns the first response without storing a second file
tests.setup: A valid member and a fixed idempotency key. First POST returns 201 with a file id.
tests.action: Send the same request again within 24 hours (fake clock).
tests.expected: The second response is byte-identical to the first. The count of stored files for the key is 1.

tests.name: same key after 24 hours is processed as a new request
tests.rule: The replay window is 24 hours
tests.setup: As above, with the fake clock advanced to 24 hours and one second.
tests.expected: A new file is stored. Whether the response is new is confirmed by the spec owner (see spec_findings).

tests.name: different key with the same body stores a second file
tests.rule: The idempotency key identifies the request
tests.setup: Two requests, same body, different keys.
tests.expected: Two files are stored.

spec_findings: The status codes are not stated for non-member (403 or 404), oversize (413 or 400), and missing token (401).
The unit of 10 MB is not stated (10 x 1024 x 1024 bytes or 10,000,000 bytes).
Whether the idempotency key is required, or a request without one is accepted, is not stated.
Whether the key is scoped per org, per user or global is not stated.
Whether a replay with the same key and a different body is refused is not stated.
What is stored for a first request that failed is not stated.
Behaviour for two simultaneous requests with the same key is not stated.
covered: Authorization: token, membership, tenant isolation
Size limit at, above and below the boundary
Multipart validation
Idempotency within 24 hours, different keys
not_covered: Concurrent requests with the same key (spec silent)
Replay with a different body (spec silent)
Failed first request (spec silent)
Exact status codes until the spec gives them
actions_now: Write the spec-derived negative and boundary tests against a local harness with stored-file counts, and send the spec findings to the spec owner before pinning status codes.

not_covered: Two or more codes on one order: the spec is silent, so no test is written and the current largest-only behaviour is not locked in
Invalid or expired codes: spec silent

tests.expected: The session is reported expired.

spec_findings: The spec does not say whether the session is expired at exactly 15 minutes, so the exact boundary is not tested.

not_covered: The exact 15-minute boundary (spec silent)

Unit count

tests.expected: 410. The password still matches the old value.
